title: fix(gen): expose the default MCP server card at the well-known discovery path
author: patbing

gist.summary: Added GET /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json as a discovery alias for the default pollinations MCP Server Card, replacing a 404 for agent scanners that check that path. It returns the same JSON, headers and ETag as the existing SEP-2127 route at /mcp/pollinations/server-card, including support for 304 revalidation. The well-known alias follows the static discovery endpoint policy and has no edge rate limit; the existing /mcp/* route remains unchanged.
